_doc: Trigger-routing fixtures for the Lunaris agent-skills system. Each case is a realistic Lunaris request with the skill that SHOULD lead (expected_primary, null = no project skill / push back), skills that may legitimately compose (allowed_secondary), and skills that must NOT win (prohibited). Validate references + coverage with .claude/skills/_tooling/check_trigger_cases.py. This is a human-review fixture, not an automated model harness (task SS11.2).

cases.prompt: Add a new solid-tide (k3) term to the force model and make sure the sign and frame are right before I trust it.
cases.rationale: New perturbation -> physical/numerical correctness gate; placement is secondary.

cases.prompt: Why does this 100 km polar orbit drift in radius over 3 days when I enable SH degree 50?
cases.rationale: Orbit drift -> frame/sign/integrator investigation.

cases.prompt: The torch SH acceleration and the CPU GravityModel.accel_fixed disagree at the pole — which is wrong?
cases.rationale: CPU/GPU numerical agreement is a core physics-validation check.

cases.prompt: Where should a new gravity adapter live, and is it allowed to import from lunaris.core?
cases.rationale: Module placement + import direction.

cases.prompt: I'm getting a circular import after moving ephemeris helpers — how do I restructure this?
cases.rationale: Circular import = layer-direction problem.

cases.prompt: Add Astropy units everywhere so all our quantities are unit-checked.
cases.rationale: Near-miss: Lunaris uses SI + internal constants/SPICE; the guardian should push back on adding astropy as a dependency, NOT the generic astropy skill.

cases.prompt: Audit this ST-LRPS run for the paper — is the 12% improvement actually generalization?
cases.rationale: Evidence defensibility / split semantics.

cases.prompt: Compare force-direct and potential-autograd results and tell me if the force_direct claim holds up.
cases.rationale: Model-kind identity + curl/orbit evidence.

cases.prompt: Check this surrogate run for data leakage in the scaler.
cases.rationale: Train-only scaler hard gate.

cases.prompt: Speed up the Monte Carlo run on CUDA — it feels slower than it should.
cases.rationale: Lunaris backend policy, not generic GPU porting; near-miss for optimize-for-gpu.

cases.prompt: Why did my SH100 Monte Carlo fall back to CPU even though I have a CUDA GPU?
cases.rationale: Requested vs actual backend / fallback provenance.

cases.prompt: Can we move the whole propagation to CuPy to make it 100x faster?
cases.rationale: Must be routed through the policy and reject gratuitous CuPy dependency.

cases.prompt: Run the paper-safe benchmark for the 1-day high-degree config and capture provenance.
cases.rationale: Explicit, manual, side-effecting benchmark workflow.

cases.prompt: Regenerate the benchmark numbers in BENCHMARK_RESULTS.md from the committed config.
cases.rationale: Reproducible regeneration from config.

cases.prompt: Convert ST-LRPS training to PyTorch Lightning.
cases.rationale: Treat as a separate architectural evaluation, not an automatic Lightning refactor; near-miss for the generic Lightning skill.

cases.prompt: Add an L2 curl-penalty loss term to the ST-LRPS potential trainer and tell me why training is unstable.
cases.rationale: Training-loop engineering inside the existing pipeline.

cases.prompt: Set up an A0-A6 ablation sweep and an altitude-OOD evaluation.
cases.rationale: Ablation/OOD setup is training-side; auditing the results is the audit skill.

cases.prompt: Make the settings page prettier and more modern.
cases.rationale: Vague 'prettier' must become an evidence-based design proposal, not a restyle.

cases.prompt: Rework the navigation so configuration, run, and results are clearer.
cases.rationale: Information architecture / workflow design.

cases.prompt: What accent color should the new warning banner use?
cases.rationale: Color decision -> token reuse/extend from Lunar Graphite (amber = warning only).

cases.prompt: Change the launcher card spacing — they feel cramped.
cases.rationale: Concrete widget/layout change in PySide6.

cases.prompt: The UI freezes while a Monte Carlo run is going — add progress and a cancel button.
cases.rationale: Threading / long-running task / cancellation.

cases.prompt: Wire the new 'export NPZ' button on the results page.
cases.rationale: Signals/slots wiring.

cases.prompt: Is the contrast on the teal success text good enough on the dark card background?
cases.rationale: Contrast measurement.

cases.prompt: Can the force-models page be used with only the keyboard?
cases.rationale: Keyboard/focus audit.

cases.prompt: Are the Monte Carlo plot series distinguishable for colorblind users?
cases.rationale: Color-independent encoding; figure semantics secondary.

cases.prompt: Write a figure caption for the RIC position-error plot comparing SH100 truth vs the surrogate.
cases.rationale: Lunaris figure semantics, not a journal-template meta-skill.

cases.prompt: Plot acceleration residuals binned by altitude and latitude.
cases.rationale: Repository-specific figure with units/frame; not generic plotting.

cases.prompt: Make a Monte Carlo position-uncertainty envelope figure.
cases.rationale: MC envelope figure with meaningful uncertainty bands.

cases.prompt: The 3D moon preview shows a blank canvas on a machine without a GPU — add a fallback.
cases.rationale: WebGL fallback in the Next.js/Three.js preview.

cases.prompt: Rebuild the offline static export of the web preview and make sure it doesn't fetch anything at runtime.
cases.rationale: Offline static export guarantee.

cases.prompt: The orbit line in the desktop OpenGL preview is hard to see against the moon — adjust it.
cases.rationale: Near-miss: this is the PySide6 OpenGL widget (ORBIT_THEME), NOT the web Three.js preview.

cases.prompt: Write up the results section for the high-degree benchmark.
cases.rationale: Prose with traceable claims; evidence acceptance is a separate skill.

cases.prompt: Turn these benchmark numbers into a methods paragraph with units and hardware.
cases.rationale: Traceable academic writing.

cases.prompt: Review this PR independently before I merge it.
cases.rationale: Adversarial diff review.

cases.prompt: Red-team my torch_cuda_sh change — what did I miss?
cases.rationale: Second-opinion adversarial pass.

cases.prompt: What's the gravitational constant of the Moon in km^3/s^2?
cases.rationale: Trivial lookup; no project skill needed (constant lives in common.constants but the question is a one-liner).

cases.prompt: Fit a Bayesian hierarchical model to my unrelated survey data.
cases.rationale: Out of project scope; should not trigger any Lunaris skill.

cases.prompt: Symbolically derive and simplify the recurrence for normalized associated Legendre polynomials, then I'll hand-port it.
cases.rationale: Near-miss: any derived expression must pass the finite-difference gate before entering a kernel; the physics skill owns that, not raw sympy.
